claim: Avoid Walmart Goodyear, Kelly, and Douglas tires. - Reddit
summary: Avoid Walmart Goodyear, Kelly, and Douglas tires. Over 15 years of owning a tire shop these are my least favorite tires. They are flimsy and delicate and I often see rocks snap the belts and cause catastrophic failure of the tires. I have a major used tire shop and I won't sell Walmart tires to my customers. I just throw them away when I get them.
